case-sara.text: [Embarrassed] I tell my friends I'm fine, then get irritated when they stop asking.
case-sara.suggestion: You say you are fine, then feel upset when they stop asking. I wonder if you wish someone would notice that there is more you have not said.

case-sara.text: [Embarrassed] I stay late at work after the breakup, because getting home early feels worse.
case-sara.suggestion: Staying late keeps you away from the quiet apartment; maybe going home early brings the aloneness closer.

case-sara.text: [Embarrassed] I call myself dramatic when I still cry about it, even though I only do it alone.
case-sara.suggestion: Calling yourself dramatic turns the tears into something to hide; I wonder if there is shame about still needing to grieve.

case-sara.text: [Softly] When someone asks how I'm doing, I smile and change the subject.
case-sara.suggestion: You move away quickly with the smile; I wonder if being honestly seen feels both wanted and too exposed.

case-sara.text: [Embarrassed] When couples post anniversary photos, I roll my eyes and scroll past too fast.
case-sara.suggestion: The eye roll helps you get past it quickly; maybe underneath it there is an ache for that kind of closeness.

case-sara.text: [Tearful] I unfollowed him, then borrowed my friend's phone to check if he looked happier.
case-sara.suggestion: You are trying to stop looking and still need to know; I wonder if part of you is afraid he is relieved you are gone.

case-sara.text: [Softly] I tell myself other people have real problems, so I should be grateful.
case-sara.suggestion: You make your pain smaller before anyone else can; I guess you may be protecting yourself from being dismissed.

case-sara.text: [Embarrassed] I drafted an apology to him three times this week, even though I do not know what I did wrong.
case-sara.suggestion: The apology gives you something concrete to fix; I wonder if finding fault in yourself feels less helpless than not knowing why he left.

case-sara.text: [Tearful] Nights are the worst; I replay little moments until I find something I could have done differently.
case-sara.suggestion: The replay keeps looking for a handle; maybe blaming yourself gives you a way to feel less powerless with the loss.

case-sara.text: [Softly] When you're kind, I look down and want to change the topic.
case-sara.suggestion: Kindness seems hard to take in directly; maybe it touches a longing you are afraid to show.

case-sara.text: [Dismissive, then quiet] He can keep the photos. I don't need them. I did look to see whether he'd taken ours down, though.
case-sara.suggestion: I wonder if seeing whether the photos are still there is also a way of checking whether you still matter to him.

case-sara.text: [Apologetic] I nearly asked my sister to stay another night. Then I thought she'd already done enough, so I made it sound as though I wanted the flat to myself.
case-sara.suggestion: Maybe it felt risky to let her see you still wanted company, in case that was more than she wanted to give.

case-michael.text: [Firm] If someone questions me in a meeting, I answer fast and louder than I meant to.
case-michael.suggestion: You answer quickly and loudly when someone questions you. I wonder if there is a moment of feeling exposed before you respond.

case-michael.text: [Defensive] When a coworker corrects me in front of the room, I laugh it off and then feel heat shoot up my neck.
case-michael.suggestion: The laugh covers it fast; I wonder if there is a quick flash of humiliation underneath.

case-michael.text: [Tense] My wife says I am harsh, and I tell her I am just being honest.
case-michael.suggestion: Honesty is the safer position to stand behind; I wonder if softening would bring you closer to guilt.

case-michael.text: [Firm] I keep favors even. I do not like owing anyone.
case-michael.suggestion: You keep the balance carefully; I wonder if owing someone feels like being one-down.

case-michael.text: [Tense and ashamed] When I have to apologize, my jaw tightens and I start explaining the whole situation.
case-michael.suggestion: The explanation comes in quickly; I wonder if apologizing touches shame, almost like losing ground.

case-michael.text: [Tense] I only pour a drink after work because my wife keeps pushing; if she would stop nagging, I would not need it.
case-michael.suggestion: You connect the drinking to feeling pushed by your wife. I wonder if being blamed feels hard to bear, and the drink gives you some distance from that.

case-michael.text: [Firm] I reread everyone's work before a presentation because one mistake would come back on me.
case-michael.suggestion: You are guarding against one mistake landing on you; I wonder if blame feels expected before anything has gone wrong.

case-michael.text: [Ashamed] After I blow up, my kid looks careful around me, and I cannot meet his eyes.
case-michael.suggestion: His careful look seems to hit hard; I wonder if it touches shame about being scary to him.

case-michael.text: [Tense] When someone tells me to calm down, it sounds like they are calling me childish.
case-michael.suggestion: That phrase seems to shrink you quickly; I wonder if the anger protects against feeling dismissed.

case-michael.text: [Firm] I do not do feelings; I ask what we are going to do about it.
case-michael.suggestion: You move toward action fast; maybe feelings seem too exposing to stay with for long.

case-michael.text: [Clipped] I could have asked for help with the report. Instead I worked until midnight. I don't want people thinking they have to carry me.
case-michael.suggestion: I wonder if needing help feels close to being seen as not capable enough.

case-michael.text: [Irritated, voice dropping] My son kept asking whether I'd come to his game. I told him I'd already said yes. I've been thinking about his face since then.
case-michael.suggestion: Maybe his asking again hurt because it suggested he wasn't sure he could count on you.

case-jason.text: [Blank] I rehearse every sentence before a meeting, and then my mind still blanks when people turn toward me.
case-jason.suggestion: You prepare carefully, and then the blankness takes over; I wonder if being looked at feels like being evaluated.

case-jason.text: [Hesitant] When I get invited out, I say I am busy before I can find out whether I want to go.
case-jason.suggestion: The busy answer comes in fast; I wonder if it protects you from finding out whether you would belong.

case-jason.text: [Anxious] I hear a voice saying 'don't embarrass yourself' before I even open my mouth.
case-jason.suggestion: That warning arrives before you speak; I guess it is trying to protect you from feeling exposed.

case-jason.text: [Quietly] After I speak, I cringe for hours and imagine everyone replaying how ridiculous I sounded.
case-jason.suggestion: The cringe keeps replaying the moment; I wonder if being heard feels close to being laughed at.

case-jason.text: [Hesitant] When someone compliments me, I assume they are being polite and missed the awkward part.
case-jason.suggestion: The compliment does not quite get in; I wonder if the awkward part feels more believable than the kind words.

case-jason.text: [Ashamed] Seeing confident people makes me want to disappear, and then I hate myself for envying them.
case-jason.suggestion: Seeing their confidence makes you want to disappear. I wonder if there is sadness in the envy too, about wanting to feel that free with people.

case-jason.text: [Quietly] If someone laughs nearby, I assume it is about me and replay what I did wrong.
case-jason.suggestion: You brace for ridicule quickly; I wonder if laughter feels like proof that being visible is dangerous.

case-jason.text: [Anxious] I type a text, read it five times, and delete it before sending.
case-jason.suggestion: You edit yourself right out of contact; I wonder if reaching out feels like giving someone a chance to reject you.

case-jason.text: [Anxious] I drink before events because otherwise I stand by the wall checking my phone.
case-jason.suggestion: The drink helps you leave the wall; I wonder if it shields you from feeling exposed.

case-jason.text: [Ashamed] I stay quiet even when I have a good idea, and then replay it all day.
case-jason.suggestion: You stay hidden and then keep replaying it; maybe speaking up feels risky, but staying silent brings shame.

case-jason.text: [Hesitant] I tell people I'm busy when they invite me. Then I check whether they went without me. I know that doesn't make much sense.
case-jason.suggestion: Maybe you want to be included, and saying you're busy protects you from finding out what it would be like to join them.

case-jason.text: [Quiet] I didn't tell my friend I'd had a bad day. I asked about his instead. I kept hoping he'd notice I wasn't saying much.
case-jason.suggestion: I wonder if you wanted him to notice you needed care without having to risk asking for it.

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I fixed her lamp, though there’s nobody using it now. I keep checking it works.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder if tending to her things is one way of keeping her close. Does that fit?

case-arne.text: [Pauses] I had a story for her after the walk. It stayed in my head all evening.
case-arne.suggestion: Could part of the loneliness be having nobody to share those small stories with?

case-arne.text: [Looks down] I stopped laughing when I got home. Her photograph was right there.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder whether enjoying the afternoon suddenly felt disloyal. Or was it something else?

case-arne.text: [Sighs] I tell Emma not to worry. Then I wish she’d ask again.
case-arne.suggestion: Might you want her to know you need company, without feeling you’re burdening her?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I put her scarf away, then brought it back out.
case-arne.suggestion: Perhaps putting it away felt like a bigger goodbye than you wanted. Does that come close?

case-arne.text: [Voice lowers] The nights were exhausting. I don’t usually tell anyone that bit.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder if you worry that hearing the exhaustion, people might miss the love.

case-arne.text: [Frowning] Everyone says how strong I was. I’d rather they sat down with me.
case-arne.suggestion: Could being called strong feel like being left to manage alone?

case-arne.text: [Softly] I made her favorite soup. Eating it alone wasn’t what I’d hoped.
case-arne.suggestion: Maybe you wanted a little sense of sharing it with her, and the empty place hurt instead. Is that right?

case-arne.text: [Pauses] I keep polishing the workbench. I haven’t started anything new.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder if starting something new feels uncertain now. Or is there another reason?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I’m glad Emma calls. I listen for her name on the phone.
case-arne.suggestion: Could those calls give you a welcome feeling of still being part of someone’s day?

case-arne.text: [Looks away] I don’t like saying how much I want company.
case-arne.suggestion: Perhaps asking for company feels more exposed than talking about the practical things. Does it?

case-arne.text: [Softly] I slept through the night, and woke feeling bad about it.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder if resting seemed to mean you’d stopped caring. Is that what the guilt said?

case-arne.text: [Briskly] I don’t tell Emma about the workshop. She still cries when we mention Eva.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder if you’re protecting Emma from your enjoyment, as though it could hurt her. Does that fit?

case-arne.text: [Half-smile] I had a good day. Then I put her photograph more prominently on the shelf.
case-arne.suggestion: Could moving the photograph be a way of making sure enjoying yourself hasn’t left her out?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I can explain the hospital schedule. The tiredness is harder to say.
case-arne.suggestion: Maybe the schedule feels safer to share than how much it cost you. Is that close?

case-arne.text: [Looks away] I turned down dinner. I didn’t want them watching whether I laughed.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder if being observed makes enjoyment feel like something you have to justify.

case-arne.text: [Hesitant] I like the workshop, but I call it just passing time.
case-arne.suggestion: Might calling it “passing time” make it easier to enjoy without feeling disloyal? Or not quite?

case-arne.text: [Sighs] I keep a list of things I did for her. I don’t know why.
case-arne.suggestion: Could the list be trying to reassure you that the care was real, even when you remember exhaustion?

case-arne.text: [Dry laugh] Tom says I can call any time. I never do. That’s me.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder if using the offer feels different from having it—perhaps more exposed. Does it?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I hate “Eva would want you happy.” They make it sound so simple.
case-arne.suggestion: Could that phrase skip over how complicated enjoying life feels to you now?

case-arne.text: [Pauses] I get angry at her old chair, then apologize to the photograph.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder if there’s anger about being left with this life alone. Is that there, or something else?

case-arne.text: [Hesitant] I don’t want a new routine yet. The old one still has her in it.
case-arne.suggestion: Perhaps changing the routine feels like loosening a connection you want to keep. Does that fit?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I didn’t tell anyone I slept well. That would sound too pleased.
case-arne.suggestion: Might rest feel like something you’re not allowed to welcome while you miss her?

case-arne.text: [Looks down] I want help with the evenings, not people taking charge of me.
case-arne.suggestion: Could asking for help carry a worry about losing your say in your own life?

case-arne.text: [Watchful] I don’t call Tom. Not because I think he’ll reject me. It’s something else.
case-arne.suggestion: Might calling feel like admitting how much company you want? Or does that miss it too?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] The good day felt wrong, but not disloyal. More like wearing clothes that aren’t mine.
case-arne.suggestion: Could enjoyment feel unfamiliar in this life, rather than forbidden? Does that come closer?

case-arne.text: [Firmly] I don’t need her coat to hold onto her. I like the way it makes the hall look.
case-arne.suggestion: Then I needn’t look for a hidden reason. Is having a familiar hall part of what you value, or simply its appearance?

case-arne.text: [Pauses] I want Emma close, but I don’t want her seeing me as a job.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder if the worry is about becoming someone to manage, rather than someone to spend time with.

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I’m angry at Eva today. No, not for dying.
case-arne.suggestion: Could it be about something between you that never got heard? Or is the anger elsewhere?

case-arne.text: [Dryly] People praise the care. I’d rather they asked what I’m making at the workshop.
case-arne.suggestion: Perhaps you want to be met as Leo with interests now, not only through the care you gave. Does that fit?

case-arne.text: [Hesitant] When I say I’m managing, I hear my own voice getting stiff.
case-arne.suggestion: I wonder if “managing” leaves out something you want heard. Does it, or is the stiffness about being asked?

case-arne.text: [Quietly] I don’t want to change the room today. Tomorrow might be different.
case-arne.suggestion: Could keeping the decision yours matter more than keeping the room exactly as it is?

case-arne.text: [Watchful] Relief isn’t one thing. There was less worry for her, and less demand on me.
case-arne.suggestion: Perhaps the guilt catches the part about your own rest more than the relief for her. Is that right?

case-arne.text: [Softly] Tom didn’t make the afternoon about Eva. I could breathe easier.
case-arne.suggestion: Might there have been room to be yourself without explaining the loss? Does that capture it?

case-arne.text: [Firmly] I’m not avoiding company. I’m choosing whose company.
case-arne.suggestion: Could the important distinction be feeling met, rather than simply not being alone?

case-arne.text: [Uncertain] I felt nothing at the photograph, then warmth at the recipe. I don’t know what that means.
case-arne.suggestion: Perhaps the ordinary trace in the recipe brought her close in a different way. Does it feel that way, or not?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] Alex carried the bag. I thanked him and then went very quiet.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if accepting the help brought some sadness too. Does that fit?

case-mia.text: [Hesitant] I keep explaining that I’m not always this tired.
case-mia.suggestion: Perhaps you want people to see more of you than the tiredness?

case-mia.text: [Frowning] Ella says “don’t worry, I’ll do it,” and I get sharp.
case-mia.suggestion: Could part of that sharpness be wanting a say in how it’s done?

case-mia.text: [Thoughtful] I still bring my sketchbook, even when I don’t use it.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if having it there keeps drawing as part of your day?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I stayed after the tour just to talk about the painting.
case-mia.suggestion: Perhaps being part of the conversation mattered beyond finishing the work?

case-mia.text: [Uneasy] I say yes quickly when someone asks how I am.
case-mia.suggestion: Could you be trying to avoid having to explain the whole day?

case-mia.text: [Hesitant] Sam remembered the chair. I didn’t know what to say.
case-mia.suggestion: Maybe not having to ask again felt unexpectedly caring?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I put the pencil away so Alex wouldn’t see it there.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if you wanted to keep the disappointment to yourself?

case-mia.text: [Pauses] I want visitors, but I worry about the tidying first.
case-mia.suggestion: Perhaps you want the company without having to spend your energy preparing for it?

case-mia.text: [Reflective] I smiled when Ella asked me to choose the music.
case-mia.suggestion: Could it have felt good to be asked for something you could offer?

case-mia.text: [Frowning] I hate the word “inspiring” when people use it about me.
case-mia.suggestion: Maybe you want to be met as a person, without having to stand for a message?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I didn’t ask Alex to leave. I just needed him to stop doing things.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if you wanted his company more than his help then?

case-mia.text: [Brisk] I can list exactly what Alex did. I can’t explain why I went quiet.
case-mia.suggestion: Perhaps the help was useful, while not being asked left you feeling less included?

case-mia.text: [Dry laugh] I make jokes about the stool before anyone else can.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if joking lets you choose how people notice it?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] Ella watered the plants. Afterwards I rearranged every pot.
case-mia.suggestion: Could rearranging have been a way of having something there remain yours?

case-mia.text: [Hesitates] I say the shorter tour is fine. Then I avoid looking at the old route.
case-mia.suggestion: Maybe there’s a loss there that “fine” doesn’t quite have room for?

case-mia.text: [Reflective] Sam asked for my ideas, and I stayed longer than I’d planned.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if being wanted for your ideas made leaving particularly hard?

case-mia.text: [Uneasy] I leave out the enjoyable parts when I explain a bad week.
case-mia.suggestion: Could you worry that enjoyment would make people doubt how hard the week was?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I’m relieved when Alex goes out. Then I check when he’ll be back.
case-mia.suggestion: Perhaps you need some space and also the reassurance that you’re not alone with everything?

case-mia.text: [Brisk] I offered to choose the music. At least that didn’t involve carrying things.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if you were finding a way to contribute that felt like you?

case-mia.text: [Frowning] Everyone says I’m coping. I don’t correct them, but I dislike it.
case-mia.suggestion: Maybe that description leaves you with no easy way to say how hard it is?

case-mia.text: [Uncertain] I put off asking for help until it becomes obvious I need it.
case-mia.suggestion: Could waiting spare you the difficult moment of having to name the need?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I want Alex to notice. But when he notices too much, I bristle.
case-mia.suggestion: Perhaps you want to be understood without being continually monitored?

case-mia.text: [Half-smiles] I told Ella I didn’t need anything. Then I wished she’d stay for tea.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if company felt hard to ask for when it wasn’t a practical need?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I thanked him twice. Then wished I hadn’t made such a performance of it.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if you felt you had to make receiving help easier for him? Or is that off?

case-mia.text: [Flatly] I left the drawing out. It annoys me when Alex tidies it away.
case-mia.suggestion: Could leaving it there keep a choice open, even when you aren’t drawing?

case-mia.text: [Corrects] Not ashamed of needing the chair. I just don’t want the speech that comes with it.
case-mia.suggestion: Perhaps the unwanted attention is harder than the chair itself?

case-mia.text: [Hesitates] I want Ella to ask. I don’t always know my answer when she does.
case-mia.suggestion: Maybe you need permission to take time, as well as permission to choose?

case-mia.text: [Dryly] My good day became everyone’s good news. I went quiet.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if their relief left little room for what was still difficult for you?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I tell Alex to go out, then wish he’d see that I wanted something else.
case-mia.suggestion: Could asking directly for company feel more exposed than asking him to go?

case-mia.text: [Uneasy] Sam asked me to lead the discussion. I was pleased, then annoyed.
case-mia.suggestion: Perhaps being wanted also brought pressure to give more than you could manage?

case-mia.text: [Corrects] I don’t need an easier hobby. That’s not what the drawing was about.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if drawing held a part of your life that a replacement wouldn’t simply fill?

case-mia.text: [Softly] I stayed quiet because I couldn’t bear another helpful answer.
case-mia.suggestion: Maybe you wanted someone to hear the difficulty without immediately changing it?

case-mia.text: [Thoughtful] I know the shorter tour works. I haven’t told anyone what I miss in it.
case-mia.suggestion: Could saying what you miss feel risky, as if it might sound like rejecting the adjustment?

case-mia.text: [Quietly] I wanted my effort noticed. When it was, I wanted to hide.
case-mia.suggestion: I wonder if recognition felt good until it made you too visible? Does that catch any of it?

case-mia.text: [Tired] I keep saying “I’m fine” here too. You’re not asking me to.
case-mia.suggestion: Could that familiar answer arrive before you’ve had time to decide what you want to share?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I straightened the drawings after the meeting. I couldn’t start working.
case-nora.suggestion: I wonder if the comment had made it hard to feel at home with your own work?

case-nora.text: [Hesitant] I rehearsed explaining Norway again, even though nobody was asking.
case-nora.suggestion: Perhaps you were preparing to have your answer questioned again?

case-nora.text: [Frowning] Max helped, and I still went quiet.
case-nora.suggestion: Could the help have left you wanting more room for your own words?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I wanted Adam beside me, but I didn’t tell him the story.
case-nora.suggestion: Maybe company felt more helpful than having to explain it once more?

case-nora.text: [Dry laugh] I make the joke about where I’m from before they can.
case-nora.suggestion: I wonder if joking gives you some choice in how the moment happens?

case-nora.text: [Thoughtful] I stayed in the conversation when it was about the photographs.
case-nora.suggestion: Perhaps it felt good to be met through something you enjoy?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I don’t correct them every time. Then I feel bad about that.
case-nora.suggestion: Could you be judging yourself for conserving energy you actually need?

case-nora.text: [Uneasy] I explain that I like my job before I mention the comment.
case-nora.suggestion: Maybe you want to make sure the hurt isn’t heard as rejecting everything about the work?

case-nora.text: [Hesitant] I wanted someone to say they noticed. I didn’t need a speech.
case-nora.suggestion: Perhaps a simple acknowledgment would have helped you feel less alone?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I kept my voice calm, and afterwards I shook.
case-nora.suggestion: I wonder if holding the meeting together left feelings with nowhere to go until afterwards?

case-nora.text: [Reflective] I want to ask Max to wait, but I keep softening the request.
case-nora.suggestion: Could you worry that a clear request might sound like rejecting his support?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] Lina didn’t ask another question. I was glad she stayed.
case-nora.suggestion: Maybe being accompanied mattered more than finding more words then?

case-nora.text: [Brisk] I gave Lina the dates and exact words. She’d already said she believed me.
case-nora.suggestion: I wonder if proving it had become hard to stop, even with someone who believed you?

case-nora.text: [Dry laugh] I’m very good at sounding unbothered. I don’t feel unbothered.
case-nora.suggestion: Perhaps sounding that way helps you keep some control of what others see?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] Max defended me and I started correcting small details.
case-nora.suggestion: Could correcting the details have been a way to get your voice back into the conversation?

case-nora.text: [Uneasy] I explain how much I like the job before asking for the credit.
case-nora.suggestion: Maybe you worry the request will be heard as disloyalty rather than a fair claim?

case-nora.text: [Hesitates] I want an apology, but I dread the meeting they’d arrange for it.
case-nora.suggestion: Could the attention itself feel costly, even if the acknowledgment is wanted?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I wanted Adam there. I said I was fine before he sat down.
case-nora.suggestion: I wonder if that familiar answer arrived before you could ask for company?

case-nora.text: [Thoughtful] I enjoyed dinner, then started rereading my notes from the meeting.
case-nora.suggestion: Perhaps leaving it alone brought a worry that nobody else would keep it in view?

case-nora.text: [Frowning] I don’t know why he interrupted. I’ve prepared three explanations for why it bothered me.
case-nora.suggestion: Could you feel you need certainty about his motive before your reaction gets a hearing?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] Being asked about the photographs felt almost surprising.
case-nora.suggestion: Maybe you’d been expecting to explain your background, rather than share an interest?

case-nora.text: [Brisk] I can explain the comment clearly. I get stuck on what it did to me.
case-nora.suggestion: I wonder if giving the hurt words feels more exposing than quoting the comment?

case-nora.text: [Hesitant] I don’t want to be praised for how calmly I handled it.
case-nora.suggestion: Could the praise make it harder to say that you weren’t actually okay?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I want Max to notice, but I’d like him to check before stepping in.
case-nora.suggestion: Perhaps you want an ally beside you, with the decision still yours?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I soften the comment when I tell it. Even to Lina.
case-nora.suggestion: I wonder if you soften it to spare Lina, even though you think she could hear it as it was?

case-nora.text: [Flatly] I haven’t put the drawings away. I haven’t worked on them either.
case-nora.suggestion: Could leaving them there let you come back to them, without having to do it today?

case-nora.text: [Corrects] Not ashamed of my background. Tired of it being the only introduction.
case-nora.suggestion: Perhaps you want more choice in which part of you enters the conversation first?

case-nora.text: [Hesitates] Max asked what I wanted. I didn’t know quickly enough for him.
case-nora.suggestion: Maybe you needed time for an answer as well as a chance to give one?

case-nora.text: [Dryly] They praised my composure. I made another calm reply.
case-nora.suggestion: I wonder if that praise made it harder to show the cost underneath?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I want acknowledgment from Ben. I keep imagining having to thank him for it.
case-nora.suggestion: Could receiving it feel complicated if you expect another obligation afterwards?

case-nora.text: [Uneasy] I asked Max to stop. Now I’m worried he’ll stop noticing altogether.
case-nora.suggestion: Perhaps you wanted his attention changed, rather than his support withdrawn?

case-nora.text: [Corrects] The silence wasn’t giving up. I needed some of the afternoon left for me.
case-nora.suggestion: I wonder if keeping quiet protected time you didn’t want this to consume?

case-nora.text: [Softly] I wanted a plain “I noticed.” The long response made me tired.
case-nora.suggestion: Maybe the simple acknowledgment mattered more than being offered another interpretation?

case-nora.text: [Thoughtful] I want the job to include me. I don’t want that wish called needing their approval.
case-nora.suggestion: Could it be a wish for a fair place at work, rather than for everyone to approve of you?

case-nora.text: [Quietly] I enjoyed dinner, then felt I’d left something unguarded.
case-nora.suggestion: I wonder if putting it aside felt risky, as though the event might be forgotten? Does that fit?

case-nora.text: [Tired] I keep answering “fine” before I’ve worked out whether I want to answer at all.
case-nora.suggestion: Could the familiar reply arrive before your choice has had time to form?
